source: User instruction: use the Okinawa sea-experiment underwater calibration for child and parent cameras going forward.
policy: Use the matching main-video or proxy matrix, rescale intrinsics for full-frame resizing, preserve distortion. Explicit overrides take precedence. Record actual source/hash/geometry in every analysis manifest. Do not apply this underwater model to air images without marking the medium mismatch. No IMU extrinsic or time synchronization is implied.
